99d1aac6bd493749bd5db715d4ccb398a3fd8579.name: GetPrice
99d1aac6bd493749bd5db715d4ccb398a3fd8579.query:
query GetPrice($assetA: String!, $assetB: String!) {
  getPrice(assetA: $assetA, assetB: $assetB) {
    assetA
    assetB
    pairKey
    price
    sdexPrice
    ammPrice
    bestRoute
    volume24h
    sdexVolume24h
    ammVolume24h
    vwap1m
    vwap5m
    vwap1h
    vwap24h
    priceChange24h
    lastUpdated
    sources
    confidence
    lastTradeAgeSeconds
  }
}

47c189a4cea77c48994a7d9c8b0ce810733f5e03.name: GetPriceHistory
47c189a4cea77c48994a7d9c8b0ce810733f5e03.query:
query GetPriceHistory($assetA: String!, $assetB: String!, $window: String!, $limit: Int) {
  getPriceHistory(assetA: $assetA, assetB: $assetB, window: $window, limit: $limit) {
    bucket
    window
    vwap
    sdexVwap
    ammVwap
    volume
    tradeCount
    open
    close
    high
    low
  }
}
